scripts.dev: npm run build -w @gog/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @gog/shared" "npm run dev -w @gog/server" "npm run dev -w @gog/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gog/shared && npm run build -w @gog/server && npm run build -w @gog/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @gog/shared && npm run typecheck -w @gog/server && npm run typecheck -w @gog/web
